anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: All temperature sensors T701-T712 not installed; no thermal profile available to verify separation or column state
Reflux ratio indicator pinned to a few discrete values (3.64/3.90) and inconsistent with FT703/FT704 ratio (~0.08/0.42 ≈ 0.2)
Reflux flow mostly ~0.08 L/h with sporadic spikes to 0.2-0.38 L/h
Distillate transient to 0.658 L/h at k=19 with PDI702 jump 2.0->3.7 mbar, partially recovering at k=20

args.missing_evidence: Any column temperature reading (all T sensors uninstalled), a composition/GC sample of distillate, and the intended reflux ratio setpoint to check FYI702 consistency against FT703/FT704
